name: Drone Remote ID
description: Bluetooth Remote ID advertisements from ASTM F3411 and ASD-STAN EN 4709-002 (required by non-recreational or > 250g drones)
author: BLESPloit
notes: Legacy and extended BLE Remote ID: GAP AD type 0x16, UUID 0xFFFA (ASTM Remote ID), application code 0x0D, an 8-bit message counter, then one 25-byte Drone Remote ID message. vars.adv_mode legacy rotates Basic ID, Location, and System as separate Bluetooth 4 advertisements (a pack does not fit in 31 bytes). vars.adv_mode ble5 sends those three messages in one Bluetooth 5 extended advertisement as a message pack (type 0xF) on LE Coded PHY (long range). Both profiles use a static random address generated when the profile starts. The first physical button toggles between those two broadcasts. Protocol version 0 is ASTM F3411-19, version 1 is ASD-STAN prEN 4709-002 P1, version 2 is ASTM F3411-22a. Based on https://github.com/opendroneid/opendroneid-core-c
